stt: Ask HN: Does anybody else get bad carpal tunnel/RSI? Any tips?
x:
I had some issues that I localized to my right index finger.  I apparently click a lot.  So my mouse was the main issue.

I did end up buying a MS ergonomic keyboard which I liked, but ultimately, a new mouse is what was the best solution for me.

http://www.amazon.com/3M-Ergonomic-Mouse-SMALL-MEDIUM/dp/B00...

(note it comes in large also).  I tried a couple of other designs, but I liked the 3M one the best.  It's weird at first, but works well.  Thumb for left/right click.  I also use the button that's on the stick for scrolling.  It's sort of a grab and scroll motion, that works really well.  I had to use a utility to implement it: http://www.marcmoini.com/sx_en.html

stt: Ask HN: Have you ever had Carpal Tunnel Syndrome? How did you deal with it?
x:
Yep, I bought the 3M Ergonomic Mouse - it's not really a mouse, it's more like a joystick.

http://www.amazon.com/3M-Ergonomic-Optical-Compatible-EM500G...

If you want to continue using a regular mouse, switch hands (it takes a bit of getting used to).  Or buy a wrist guard that keeps your wrist straight.  That helps a bit.
